title: 第5章工欲善其事必先利其器-《穿越60带着空间当保安》
content:
第(1/3)页

    王野带着弟弟妹妹在院子里玩着，李叔家老大李卫国、老二姑娘李凤芝，刘叔家的三个儿子刘龙、刘虎、刘豹也陆续加入进来。

    听着大街上的喇叭里放起了时代感十足的歌曲，王野知道这是六点了，因为现在大部分家里没有钟表。一般就两种办法估算时间，一个是看太阳，再一个就是听大喇叭里的广播。

    过了没一会儿，王铁柱、刘叔、赵爷爷一起回到院里。各家的妇女也叫着各家的娃娃回家吃饭。

    现在这个时代，可没有谁家会客气着叫别人来家吃饭，因为都是定量，别人多吃一份，就意味着自家有一个人得饿一顿。

    王铁柱进院子就直奔笑笑走来，对于两个儿子视而不见：“宝贝闺女，想爹了没？”

    王野看着他爹那一脸女儿奴的嘴脸，要不是这是亲爹，说什么都得鄙视他一脸。

    “想，可想可想！”

    小丫头一边说着一边拍着自己的肚子。王野也不知道想不想和肚子有什么关系。

    王铁柱抱着女儿回到堂屋，王野和王江河也跟着进屋。秦婉已经把饭端到桌子上。王铁柱看着桌子上的十个大馒头，吃惊地问道：“孩儿他娘，这是有什么喜事呀，伙食这么好？”

    秦婉拉了拉王铁柱的衣袖：“你先坐下，我慢慢跟你说。”

    王野和王江河坐下后自顾自地吃着，王野也不明白怎么回事儿，中午才吃了三个大馒头，这才六点多就饿得不行了。

    秦婉小声地跟丈夫说着大儿子今天的丰功伟绩。王铁柱吃惊地看着王野：“行啊！大儿子长大了，知道帮家里减轻负担了，但出去也要注意安全。”

    现在的十五六的半大小子，一般家里早就放养了。能嘱咐一句就是相当负责任了。这在农村，这么大的半大小子都有结婚的了。王野点着头也不搭话。

    饭后一家人都去大门口乘凉了。王野自己回到屋里，继续琢磨以后的计划。短期计划得想办法多往家里弄点吃食，这一家全都营养不良。

    中期计划得找个工作，过不了几年就要起风了，到时候没工作的都得去上山下乡，王野这种没工作没户口的统称盲流，到时候会被遣返，想想这一大家子，这要是他被遣返回乡了，十年八年回不来，到时候吃屎都赶不上热乎的。

    长期计划得为以后的幸福生活努力，学学前辈们收收古董，买几座四合院，到了九十年代以后，妥妥的富一代。

    短期计划不难，有空间在身，只要把空间里的物资想办法洗白了就可以了。中期计划不太容易，王野家没有什么背景，想要找个好工作得花大价钱买人家的指标，这得随缘。

    但是指望王铁柱还是算了，他的工资最多保证王野这一大家子饿不死。长期计划：回忆着原主的记忆，加上王野的认知，悲哀地发现傻眼了，他对古董是七窍通了六窍，一窍不通。

    四合院就更不要想了。现在都是国家资产，你想买，就问你够资格吗？别说一位位二代，就是一个街道办干事，他也惹不起呀！

    憋屈呀！不想了，随缘吧！还是琢磨琢磨怎么弄吃的吧。首先一条，得给自己树个人设，钓鱼达人，打猎宗师。这都是前辈们总结出来的经验。这两个人设，无外乎三个条件，技术，装备，和运气。

    技术有空间辅助，王野发现空间里可以做些简单的加工，木头之类的东西可以压缩改变密度，像石头，金属就不行了。不知道以后可不可以。

    运气虚无缥缈咋说咋是。剩下的就是装备了，说干就干，想办法手搓一套神器渔具。

    王野回忆着前世的渔具，太高级了，玻璃纤维，碳纤维。这东西真要是能拿出来，进科学院都不成问题。

    再说了，就王野一个前世的屌丝，最多知道那种多少钱，至于工艺，只能呵呵了。

    那只能根据现有的条件制作鱼竿了。用什么呢？肯定是竹子了。现在大众都是这种鱼竿，供销社就有卖的，最好的就是厘竹鱼竿了，有三节四节之分，一般三节的三块，四节的三块五，四节对是顶配了。

    这东西也不是一般人家买得起的，同样也不能凸显出王野的不同。再说了，就是最好的鱼竿，钓个十斤八斤的就到天了。来到院子里看见墙角堆着一捆毛竹，这东西可粗，直径十好几公分，长度也有十几米，这是前些年搭棚子用的。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Wang Ye was playing in the yard with his younger brothers and sisters. The eldest son of Uncle Li’s family, Li Weiguo, the second youngest girl, Li Fengzhi, and the three sons of Uncle Liu’s family, Liu Long, Liu Hu, and Liu Bao, also joined in one after another.

Listening to the contemporary songs playing from the speakers on the street, Wang Ye knew it was six o'clock, because most homes now don't have clocks.Generally, there are two ways to estimate the time, one is to look at the sun, and the other is to listen to the broadcast on the loudspeaker.

After a while, Wang Tiezhu, Uncle Liu, and Grandpa Zhao returned to the courtyard together.The women of each family also called their children home for dinner.

In this day and age, no one would politely ask others to come over for a meal, because the food is all rationed, and if someone else eats an extra portion, it means someone in the family will be hungry.

Wang Tiezhu walked straight towards Xiaoxiao as soon as he entered the yard, turning a blind eye to his two sons: "My dear daughter, do you miss your father?"

Wang Ye looked at his father's face as if he were a daughter-in-law. If he hadn't been his biological father, he would have looked down upon him no matter what he said.

"Think about it, think about it!"

The little girl patted her belly as she spoke.Wang Ye didn't know if it had anything to do with his stomach.

Wang Tiezhu carried his daughter back to the main room, followed by Wang Ye and Wang Jianghe.Qin Wan has already put the rice on the table.Wang Tiezhu looked at the ten big steamed buns on the table and asked in surprise: "My dear, what kind of happy event is this? The food is so good?"

Qin Wan pulled Wang Tiezhu's sleeve: "Sit down first and I will tell you slowly."

Wang Ye and Wang Jianghe sat down and ate by themselves. Wang Ye didn't understand what was going on. He only ate three big steamed buns at noon, and he was so hungry after six o'clock.

Qin Wan whispered to her husband about her eldest son's great achievements today.Wang Tiezhu looked at Wang Ye in surprise: "Okay! The eldest son has grown up and knows that he can help reduce the burden on the family, but he must also pay attention to safety when going out."

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​ away from home.It would be quite responsible if I could just tell you something.In the countryside, all young men of this age are already married.Wang Ye nodded and said nothing.

After the meal, the whole family went to the gate to enjoy the cool air.Wang Ye returned to the house by himself and continued to think about future plans.The short-term plan is to find a way to get more food at home. This family is all malnourished.

The mid-term plan is to find a job. The epidemic will start in a few years. By then, those without jobs will have to go to the mountains and countryside. People like Wang Ye who have no jobs and no registered residence are collectively called blind migrants. They will be deported by then. Think about this big family. If he is deported back to his hometown, he will not be able to come back for ten or eight years. By then, he will not be able to keep up with the heat of eating shit.

The long-term plan is to work hard for a happy life in the future. Learn from the predecessors who collected antiques and bought a few courtyard houses. After the 1990s, they became a wealthy generation.

Short-term planning is not difficult. If you have space, you just need to find a way to clean up the materials in the space.Medium-term planning is not easy. Wang Yejia doesn't have much background. If he wants to find a good job, he has to spend a lot of money to buy other people's indicators. This has to be random.

But it’s better to count on Wang Tiezhu. His salary can at most ensure that Wang Ye and his family will not starve to death.Long-term plan: Recalling the memory of the original owner, coupled with Wang Ye's knowledge, he sadly found that he was dumbfounded. He knew everything about antiques, but knew nothing about them.

Don’t even think about the courtyard house.Now they are all national assets. If you want to buy them, I ask if you are qualified?Not to mention the second generation, even a street office worker, he can't afford to offend him!

It’s so frustrating!Don’t think about it anymore, just let it happen!It’s better to think about how to get food.First of all, you must establish a personal profile for yourself, a fishing expert and a hunting master.These are the experiences summed up by our predecessors.These two characters are nothing more than three conditions, technology, equipment, and luck.

Technology is assisted by space. Wang Ye discovered that simple processing can be done in space. Things like wood can be compressed and changed in density, but not stone and metal.I don’t know if it will be possible in the future.

How can you say that luck is ethereal?All that's left is the equipment, just do it and find a way to make a set of magical fishing gear.

Wang Ye recalled the fishing gear from his previous life. It was so high-end, made of glass fiber and carbon fiber.If this thing could be produced, it would not be a problem to enter the Academy of Sciences.

“Besides, Wang Ye, a loser in his previous life, knows how much it costs at most. As for the craftsmanship, I can only guess.

Then we can only make fishing rods based on the existing conditions.What to use?It must be bamboo.Nowadays, most people use this kind of fishing rod, which is sold by supply and marketing cooperatives. The best one is the Lizhu fishing rod, which has three sections and four sections. Generally, three sections cost 3 yuan, and four sections cost 3.5 yuan. A pair of four sections is the best match.

This thing is not something that ordinary people can afford, and it also cannot highlight Wang Ye's difference.Besides, if you use the best fishing rod, you will be lucky if you can catch a fish weighing ten or eight pounds.When I came to the yard, I saw a bundle of moso bamboo piled in the corner. This thing is quite thick, with a diameter of more than ten centimeters and a length of more than ten meters. This was used to build sheds in previous years.
